name: 13.56MHz RFID Reader & Card
description: Like a contactless hotel keycard! Transmits electromagnetic radio waves to read smart tags.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a contactless hotel keycard! Transmits electromagnetic radio waves to read smart tags.
wiringGuidance: Connect 3.3V (Red) to 3.3V ONLY! Connect GND (Dark Slate) to GND, RST to Pin 9, SDA to Pin 10, MOSI to Pin 11, MISO to Pin 12, SCK to Pin 13 (Orange wires).
commonMistakes: Connecting VCC to 5V (permanently fries the RC522 RFID silicon!).
Loose jumper wire connections on the 8-pin header.

miniExperiment.title: Smart Card UID Reader
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 3.3V, GND to GND, RST to 9, SDA to 10, MOSI to 11, MISO to 12, SCK to 13.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor displays the hex UID whenever an RFID card or keychain is tapped against the coil.
